Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint16_t> aes3_data_type_l;
▽ △
Description:
std::uint16_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined aes3_data_
type_l 8 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype AAF.
The value range for event shall be:
0x00 00...0x00 FF : valid
0x01 00...0xFF FF : not used
For transmission, if format is set to a value which represents a AES3 stream data encapsulation
the middleware shall set value of aes3_data_type_h to the configured value, if it is not provided
by the application.
Visibility:
protected
